collection.credit:
HEATHEN-ONLY EVENTS (HE-01 to HE-45, draft for the owner, 2026-11-23, target v1.35.98)
New Believers only. Island events about the Heathens' own lives: honoring their dead, Heathen versions of events our villagers already have, and small moments of camp life.

collection.description: An older Heathen is teaching a child to count with pebbles on a flat stone by the hut.

description_variants.description: An older Isolan is teaching a child to count with pebbles on a flat stone by the hut.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) is teaching (friend) to count, using pebbles on a flat stone by the hut. (friend) keeps getting bored and building towers with the pebbles instead.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) is patient. By the end of the week (friend) can count to twenty, and back again, and is impossible to stop.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) gives up and starts counting the towers. Then the pebbles in each tower. Then the towers that fall down. (friend) learns to count anyway, and doesn't notice.
